name: Tokitou Kasumi
source:
Kasumi is [url=/c10696]Kazuki’s[/url] older cousin and acts like his big sister. She is usually the school’s model student, but reveals a playful and spoiled side when around Kazuki. As Algester said before, she is very attractive to girls even to the point of giving love letters. She holds a close relationship to [url=/c1560]Gin[/url] but seems oblivious as to what possible implications could entail. Kasumi is currently the strongest dancer and regarded as the favorite to be the next Beltina.

[Edited from [url=http://verbalrubbish.oniichannoecchi.com/?p=4098&cpage=1#comment-107931]m3rryweather's review[/url]]
